description: Hip roof for a width × depth footprint: four slopes at the same pitch meeting at a ridge along the longer side (a pyramid on a square), a fascia band and a flat soffit under overhanging eaves, and a ridge cap. Built as one closed solid (the attic is filled); there is no straight skeleton node yet, so footprints are rectangles. Pivot at the centre of the wall-top plane; the eaves hang below y = 0 by overhang × tan(pitch). Pieces: roof (roof_tiles on the slopes, wood_dark fascia and soffit), roof_ridge (roof_tiles). Every piece is closed.

thickness.desc: fascia height measured square to the slope (m)

solid.note: soffit, four fascia quads, two slopes and two hip ends around a ridge along the longer side; prim groups tiles, fascia

center: =Math.min(width, depth) / 2 * Math.tan(pitch * Math.PI / 180) + thickness / Math.cos(pitch * Math.PI / 180)

pivot: =Math.min(width, depth) / 2 * Math.tan(pitch * Math.PI / 180) + thickness / Math.cos(pitch * Math.PI / 180)
